title: Render play #{{runIndex}}
description: Create a video from this recording in ADOFAI. Recorded camera and microphone clips use your current replay settings.
dmNoteUnavailable: Configure the ImplDmNote offline renderer in TUFReplay-Renderer to enable this.
keepGameOpen: Keep ADOFAI open while the video is being created. Missing camera or microphone recordings are skipped.

status.failed: The video could not be created

errors.renderer_missing: Install TUFReplay-Renderer and restart ADOFAI, then try again.
errors.namespace_not_found: Install TUFReplay-Renderer and restart ADOFAI, then try again.
errors.orbit_missing: Enable OrbitRender and TUFReplay-Renderer, then restart ADOFAI.
errors.render_busy: Another video is being rendered. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.replay_busy: Stop replay playback before rendering a video.
errors.render_export_busy: Another recording is being prepared. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.
errors.render_recording_incompatible: This recording lacks timing or judgment data needed for rendering. Record a new run with the current TUFReplay version.
errors.level_file_missing: The level file is missing. Restore the original level file and try again.
errors.level_gameplay_modified: The level's gameplay has changed. Restore a matching level file and try again.
errors.render_export_failed: The recording could not be prepared. Check the level file and free disk space, then try again.
errors.render_export_not_found: This preparation job has expired. Start rendering again.
errors.run_not_found: This play record no longer exists. Refresh the activity list.
errors.ipc_unavailable: ADOFAI could not be reached. Keep the game open and try again.
errors.ipc_timeout: ADOFAI did not respond in time. Check the game and try again.
errors.failed: The video could not be created. Check ADOFAI and try again.
